description: Recorded Kalshi BTC bracket markets (settled) and Coinbase BTC-USD 1-minute candles, 2026-03-22/23.

candles.source: Coinbase Exchange public API, GET /products/BTC-USD/candles, granularity=60
candles.format: [unix_ts, low, high, open, close, volume] per row, ascending

KXBTC15M.note: 15-minute 'BTC price at close >= strike' markets; strike is the BRTI value at the previous close

KXBTCD.note: 60-minute 'BTC price above threshold' markets; many strikes per event

markets.source: Kalshi public market endpoints (GET /markets, GET /events) recorded after settlement
markets.settlement_source: CF Benchmarks Bitcoin Real-Time Index (BRTI); expiration_value is the settlement value Kalshi reported

quotes.note: No order-book snapshots were recorded for these markets. The backtest models entry quotes as GBM fair value at the implied_vol below plus a half-spread, rounded to cents. Win rate and settlement-basis statistics do not depend on this; P&L does.
